name: MITF-M melanocyte gene regulation with UV and light response
rationale: Members are MITF-M target-gene programs, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation and responses to UV-A/UV-B, blue light and TPA; the UV-response sets distinguish it from the pigmentation/melanin-synthesis confusables.

name: Cytokinetic contractile ring and spindle midzone assembly
rationale: All members concern the early cytokinesis machinery (Rho cycle, actomyosin ring, septins, furrow, midzone/spindle elongation), distinguishing it from spindle-checkpoint confusables and from the ESCRT abscission/nuclear-envelope confusable.

name: Trans-Golgi–endosome–lysosome vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover TGN vesicle biogenesis, Golgi-to-lysosome/endosome sorting and endosome-to-Golgi retrograde transport, unlike confusables centred on COPI intra-Golgi/Golgi-ER traffic or recycling to the plasma membrane.

qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/z adenylate cyclase inhibition plus calcium/PLC arm
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/z cyclase inhibition and calcium signaling
rationale: Members combine Gi/Gz-mediated adenylate cyclase inhibition via alpha-2 adrenoceptors with G protein calcium/PLC/IP3 signaling and secretion inhibition, lacking the cAMP degradation/PKA and other-receptor families of the confusables.

name: HIV-1 early replication and APOBEC3G deamination restriction
rationale: Members span HIV entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import and integration plus APOBEC3G/Vif cytidine-deamination restriction, distinguishing it from immunoglobulin diversification, ADAR editing, retroelement silencing and late HIV confusables.

name: T cell integrin adhesion and immunological synapse signaling
rationale: Members cover leukocyte integrin activation and adhesion, T cell polarity, synapse/raft assembly and CD28-Vav1/second-messenger signaling, unlike confusables on endothelial extravasation, Rho/Cdc42 effectors, homing chemotaxis or dendritic-cell IL-12.

name: Sensorimotor gating, exploratory and social behavior
rationale: Members are behavioural phenotypes (grooming, prepulse inhibition, exploration, swimming, touch/visual behaviour, social interaction) with amygdala and MECP2-GABA links, distinguished from confusables on vocal learning, mating/aggression or synaptic transmission.

qualifier: TLR7/8/9 to IRF5/IRF7 type I interferon
name: Endosomal TLR7/8/9 signaling to type I interferon
rationale: Members regulate TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signaling and their IRF5/IRF7-driven IFN-alpha/beta output in activated dendritic cells, unlike confusables on TLR3 trafficking defects, RIG-I/cGAS sensing or downstream IFN response.

name: Taste and olfactory chemosensory perception
rationale: All members are taste (sweet, bitter, umami, salty, sour), smell, odorant or pheromone perception, distinguishing it from ion-channel/pH confusables and the taste-plus-alcohol/nose-development confusable.

qualifier: antiviral restriction of foreign nucleic acids
name: Antiviral cytosine deamination of foreign nucleic acids
rationale: The three members describe APOBEC-type cytosine deamination clearing foreign nucleic acids and restricting viral replication, distinct from DNA demethylation/repair, HIV replication cycle and immunoglobulin hypermutation confusables.

qualifier: excision-repair gap filling and translesion bypass
name: PCNA-dependent DNA synthesis in excision repair and translesion bypass
rationale: Members centre on PCNA/polymerase-driven DNA synthesis: NER and long-patch BER gap filling, translesion polymerases, polymerase switching, flap removal and primer/telomere C-strand synthesis with UV damage response, unlike confusables on double-strand break repair, glycosylase/mismatch repair or telomere capping.

qualifier: replicase frameshifting, protein E maturation and host translation suppression
name: Coronavirus replicase translation and host translation suppression
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation/frameshifting, protein maturation and viral suppression of host translation elongation, lacking the genome replication, capping and other-virus pathways of the confusables.

name: Early chondrogenesis: chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation control
rationale: All members regulate chondroblast/chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and cartilage condensation, distinct from osteoblast/ossification confusables and RUNX2-driven hypertrophic maturation confusables.

name: Inositol phosphate and plasma membrane/Golgi phosphoinositide synthesis
rationale: Members are inositol phosphate metabolism and PIP synthesis at the plasma membrane and Golgi, distinguishing it from confusables on ER or endosomal PIP synthesis and Golgi membrane traffic.

core: Sulfur amino acid and selenium metabolism
qualifier: with vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors
name: Sulfur and selenium metabolism with B6 and molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine/sulfide catabolism and selenium compound metabolism together with vitamin B6 activation and molybdenum cofactor synthesis, the cofactor arm absent from glutathione and carnitine/choline confusables and the sulfur arm absent from BH4/phenylalanine confusables.

name: Locomotor and exploratory behavior with RET neurotrophic signaling
rationale: Members are locomotor, exploratory, grooming, social and nonassociative-learning behaviours plus RET/ATF neurotrophic and neuronal-specification signaling, the latter absent from all behavioural confusables (sensorimotor gating, synaptic transmission, cerebellar motor).

qualifier: multivesicular body sorting and viral budding
name: ESCRT-mediated multivesicular body sorting and viral budding
rationale: All members concern ESCRT-driven multivesicular body formation and HIV/viral budding, unlike confusables using ESCRT for cytokinetic abscission and nuclear envelope sealing or for receptor endocytosis/exosome secretion.

name: Platelet adhesion and GPCR–Rho activation signaling
rationale: Members are platelet adhesion (GPVI, GPIb-VWF, integrins), agonist GPCR signaling (thrombin, ADP, thromboxane, G12/13-Rho, Rap1) and degranulation, lacking the coagulation-factor cascade of the large confusables and the endothelial shear-stress arm of another.

qualifier: mating, aggression, parental and vocal learning
name: Social, reproductive and vocal-learning behavior
rationale: Members are intraspecies social behaviours (mating, aggression, parental care, pheromone response, vocal and observational learning), distinguished from confusables on exploration/locomotion, sensory behaviour or drinking.

qualifier: miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC action and miRNA turnover
name: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis, RISC silencing and turnover
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly, miRNA-mediated translational repression/mRNA decay and target-directed miRNA degradation, unlike confusables on specific mRNA translation targets, deadenylation, lncRNA/splicing or pri/pre-miRNA processing regulation.

qualifier: bidirectional tuning with RSK and RIT–p38 outputs
name: Ras–ERK pathway tuning and downstream RSK/p38 outputs
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of Ras and ERK signaling, tyrosine dephosphorylation, MAP2K mutants and downstream RSK and RIT/RIN–p38 branches, unlike confusables centred on RAF activation, RAS GAP/SOS mutants or ERK inactivation feedback.

name: Mevalonate isoprenoid synthesis to dolichol and lanosterol
rationale: Members span mevalonate-derived IPP, farnesyl/geranylgeranyl diphosphate, lanosterol and dolichyl-phosphate/dolichol-linked oligosaccharide synthesis, distinguishing it from post-lanosterol cholesterol, quinone/vitamin K and GPI-anchor confusables.

qualifier: netrin–DCC and L1 promoting Rac1-driven axon extension
name: Netrin–DCC and L1 guidance driving axon extension
rationale: Members are netrin/DCC, L1, ephrin and ROBO–ABL guidance cues converging on Rac1 activation and axon extension, distinguished from confusables on repulsive growth-cone collapse, Rho/Cdc42 inactivation and fasciculation.

qualifier: in reward, conditioning and locomotor behavior
name: Dopamine receptor signaling in reward and locomotor behavior
rationale: Members are D1/D2-class dopamine receptor signaling (adenylate cyclase, PLC, beta-arrestin, DARPP-32), dopaminergic transmission and dopamine-dependent conditioning, locomotion and psychostimulant responses, lacking the cocaine, opioid, neuropeptide and ethanol pathways of the confusables.

name: Glutamate biosynthesis and catabolism
rationale: All three members concern glutamate/glutamine synthesis and glutamate breakdown, distinct from urea cycle/arginine-ornithine and GABA metabolism confusables.
